conviction_note: No vinstvarning, no pre-release and no numeric guide, so the Q3 numbers are new to the market on a thin ($264k/day) name: abs_move 5.5. The two findings point opposite ways. Translation FX has stopped hurting sales and the Q2 book-to-bill was 1.09, which argues for sales at or above the 1.42bn bar. Against that, the stock rose 12.8% off its 5 Oct low on two broker upgrades premised on a Q3 order rebound of about 11% organic, and this name has fallen on four of its last five report days on margin. They sum to 0.0; p_up 47 carries the small lean from the run-up and the sell-the-print history, giving a scaled -0.33. The gap between the two numbers is the reaction history, not the fundamentals.

already_public.what: Q2 2026: orders SEK 1,482m (+6.3% CN, book-to-bill 1.09), sales 1,362m (-3.7% CN), adj EBITA 113.7m (8.3%). Outlook: 'The recent improvement in orders received also provides support for growth in the quarter ahead.' No numeric guidance, which is Nederman's normal practice.
No profit warning, trading update or other issuer release since the Q2 report. The Nasdaq Nordic feed shows Nederman's latest disclosure as the 2026-07-16 Q2 report.
Handelsbanken upgraded the stock to buy from hold, target SEK 160 (140), forecasting 11% organic order growth in Q3. The stock rose 6.8% that day.
DNB Carnegie raised its target to SEK 160 (155) and repeated buy.
Consensus of 3 analysts: Q3 EPS SEK 1.72 (2.27), sales SEK 1.42bn (1.43bn, -0.81%); FY EPS 7.00, FY sales 5.62bn.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 orders: up strongly year on year against an easy comparison (Q3 2025 was 1,251m, -7.1% CN). Whether it reaches the roughly +11% organic that Handelsbanken's upgrade priced in is uncertain. Seasonality (Q3/Q2 was 0.88 in 2025) points to about 1,300m, or roughly +4%.
Q3 sales flat to slightly up against the 1.42bn bar, helped by backlog from a 1.09 book-to-bill and neutral-to-positive FX: slight positive.
Adj EBITA margin: consensus EPS 1.72 implies about 8.5-9%, against 11.6% in Q3 2025. Unknown; this is the line the stock has traded on in 2026.
Qualitative outlook and comments on the large-project pipeline (Process Technology) and the Monitoring & Control semiconductor approval: unknown, plausibly positive in tone.
Operating cash flow positive, as management signalled in Q2; unknown in size.

findings.finding: Q3 sales are set up to land at or above the SEK 1.42bn bar. Q2 orders exceeded sales by about 120m (book-to-bill 1.09, all four divisions up), and the company's outlook says the orders 'provide support for growth in the quarter ahead'. The CFO said 'We ought to see a pickup in sales in the third quarter'. Translation FX has also turned neutral to slightly positive: Q3 2026 averages against Q3 2025 were USD/SEK +1.5% and EUR/SEK -0.1% (Yahoo daily series), where Q2 carried about 1.7pp of drag (reported -5.4% against -3.7% CN).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sales has not been the line this stock trades on. On Q2 (2026-07-16) a record order intake and a small EPS beat still saw the stock fall 1.2%; on Q1 (2026-04-17) the margin collapse drove -6.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus sits below the year-ago sales level (-0.8%) despite a 1.09 book-to-bill and the end of the FX drag. If the market had fully priced the backlog conversion, the 3-analyst bar would sit at or above 1.43bn rather than below it. The 3-analyst coverage makes the bar stale-prone.

findings.finding: The order bar was raised just before the print, and the stock has moved to meet it. Handelsbanken upgraded on 9 Oct on a forecast of about 11% organic Q3 order growth; the stock rose 6.8% that day and 12.8% from its 5 Oct close of 123.8 to 139.6. Nederman's own seasonality (Q3/Q2 orders 1,251/1,425 = 0.88 in 2025) applied to Q2 2026's 1,482m gives about 1,300m, or roughly +4%. On that path the headline order growth disappoints the thesis that drove the run-up, and the margin comparison (11.6% in Q3 2025) is hard.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Strong orders did not lift the stock on Q2 (-1.2% on 2026-07-16 with record intake). Report-day moves over 2025-26 were -2.8, +3.1, -2.8, -6.6 and -1.2: the stock has sold four of its last five prints.
findings.original_quote: "Banken bedömer att perioden med fallande orderingång närmar sig sitt slut" (the bank judges that the period of falling order intake is nearing its end); the article states the bank expects organic order growth of 11 percent in Q3.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced, by construction: the run-up is the market buying the order rebound, so this finding is about the bar having moved up rather than an unseen fact. If the market were already sceptical, the stock would not sit 12.8% above its pre-upgrade level and above both upgraded SEK 160 targets' implied path. The seasonal-ratio arithmetic is an inference from the company's own two quarters, not a company statement.

baseline_tension: The baseline's priced lean is -0.34 from the +6.7% 20-day run-up. My negative orders-bar finding agrees with it, so it is partly priced and sized small. My positive sales finding cuts against it. Net zero.
language_note: Handelsbanken's Q3 order forecast (+11% organic) and the upgrade rationale were carried only by Swedish wire copy (Börsvärlden/Finwire, Placera's recommendation list); no English source had the number. It explains the 9 Oct +6.8% day that the baseline's run-up otherwise leaves unexplained.
The Carnegie target raise of 14 Oct appeared only in Placera's Swedish recommendation list.
The filing itself (Q2 report, outlook, financial calendar) was identical in English and Swedish on the Nasdaq Nordic feed, so the local half added press, not disclosure.
lessons_applied: 'Too small about the move' plus 'thin coverage': numbers not pre-released on a 3-analyst, $264k/day name, so abs_move_pct went from 5.0 to 5.5. I did not go to 7, because Nederman gives no numeric guide and the 'none given' bucket measured 2.3%.
'Positioning is the thing to beat': the orders-bar negative agrees with the run-up-driven priced lean, so that finding went from -0.8 to -0.6 and p_up from 46 to 47.
'A finding about a number already told is worth 0': checked, and there is no trading update or vinstvarning, so the reported-quarter findings stand.
